title: Bassolino 2022 · Chronic stroke body landmarks
citation: Bassolino et al. (2022). Body and peripersonal space representations in chronic stroke patients with upper limb motor deficits. Brain Communications, 4(4), fcac179.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.placement: Secure forearm palm down, aligned with shoulder about 20 cm from midline. Place elbow 8–10 cm from table border. Record actual landmark coordinates with eyes covered, then hide the limb and shoulders using an 80 × 80 cm cover and cloth and remove the blindfold.

allocation.ordering: Randomize landmarks within blocks and test side order.

published_method.response: Show the landmark on the experimenter's body, move a 1 cm marker along the forearm axis, and record the participant's confirmed location after verbal corrections.
published_method.capture: OptiTrack V120:TRIO, Motive and custom MATLAB. Compute perceived/actual length and width ratios for each hand and arm. Shape index divides normalized width by normalized length.

stimulus_type.value: Visible manually moved marker and hidden anatomical landmark
